Extract amino acid sequence of the transcripts that harbor the somatic mutations that appear at least 5 times in the TCGA samples. 

```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(biomaRt)
library(Biostrings)
library(GenomicRanges)

theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"
```

# Read in data


## Load association results

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
res_A = fread(file.path(result_dir, "TCR_alpha_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))
res_B = fread(file.path(result_dir, "TCR_beta_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))

dim(res_A)
res_A[1:2,]

summary(res_A$pval_LRT)

w1 = which(names(res_A) == "overlap_grp") + 1
p_ct_max = apply(res_A[,w1:ncol(res_A)], 1, max)

w2kp = (p_ct_max <= 10*res_A$pval_LRT)
table(w2kp)

res_A = res_A[w2kp,]
dim(res_A)

w1 = which(names(res_B) == "overlap_grp") + 1
p_ct_max = apply(res_B[,w1:ncol(res_B)], 1, max)

w2kp = (p_ct_max <= 10*res_B$pval_LRT)
table(w2kp)

res_B = res_B[w2kp,]
dim(res_B)

tA = table(res_A$mut)
tB = table(res_B$mut)

length(tA)
length(tB)
length(union(names(tA), names(tB)))

muts_A = res_A[, .(min_pval_A = min(pval_LRT)), by = mut]
muts_B = res_B[, .(min_pval_B = min(pval_LRT)), by = mut]

dim(muts_A)
muts_A[1:2,]

dim(muts_B)
muts_B[1:2,]

muts_AB = merge(muts_A, muts_B, all = TRUE)
dim(muts_AB)
muts_AB[1:2,]

summary(muts_AB)
muts_AB$min_pval_A[is.na(muts_AB$min_pval_A)] = 0.2
muts_AB$min_pval_B[is.na(muts_AB$min_pval_B)] = 0.2

ggplot(muts_AB, mapping = aes(x = -log10(min_pval_A), y = -log10(min_pval_B))) +
  geom_pointdensity() +
  scale_color_viridis()

cor.test(muts_AB$min_pval_A, muts_AB$min_pval_B, method="spearman")

table(muts_AB$min_pval_A < 0.001, muts_AB$min_pval_B < 0.001)
muts_AB$min_pval = pmin(muts_AB$min_pval_A, muts_AB$min_pval_B, na.rm = TRUE)
table(muts_AB$min_pval < 0.001)
```

## Read in somatic mutation data

```{r}
mutation_file = "mc3.v0.2.8.CONTROLLED.maf.gz"

mut_dat = fread(file.path(data_dir, mutation_file), 
                select = c("Hugo_Symbol", "NCBI_Build", "Chromosome", "Strand", 
                           "Start_Position", "End_Position", "Reference_Allele", 
                           "Tumor_Seq_Allele1", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", 
                           "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", 
                           "Variant_Classification", "Variant_Type", 
                           "Feature", "Feature_type", "Consequence", 
                           "HGVSc", "HGVSp_Short", "Transcript_ID"))
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

mut_dat$participant = substr(mut_dat$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12)

table(mut_dat$Reference_Allele == mut_dat$Tumor_Seq_Allele1)
table(mut_dat$Reference_Allele == mut_dat$Tumor_Seq_Allele2)

mut_dat[,pos:=paste(Chromosome, Start_Position, sep=":")]
mut_dat[,key:=paste(Hugo_Symbol, pos, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2, sep=":")]

mut5 = fread(file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/mutation_freq_geq_5.tsv"))
dim(mut5)
mut5[1:2,]

table(mut5$key %in% mut_dat$key)

mut_dat = mut_dat[mut_dat$key %in% mut5$key]
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]
```

## Select mutations with similar population frequency as the TCR assocaited mutations 

```{r fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3}
unique_muts = unique(mut_dat[,.(key, Variant_Classification, participant)])
dim(unique_muts)
unique_muts[1:5,]

mut_info = unique_muts[, .(n=.N), by = .(key, Variant_Classification)]
mut_info = mut_info[order(-n)]
dim(mut_info)
mut_info[1:20,]

names(muts_AB)[1] = "key"
dim(muts_AB)
muts_AB[1:2,]

table(muts_AB$key %in% mut_info$key)

mut_info[,asso_TCR := key %in% muts_AB$key]

mut_info = merge(mut_info, muts_AB, all.x = TRUE)
dim(mut_info)
mut_info[1:2,]

table(mut_info$asso_TCR, is.na(mut_info$min_pval))

summary(mut_info$min_pval)
table(mut_info$min_pval < 0.001)

mut_info$group = "No"
mut_info$group[which(mut_info$min_pval < 0.001)] = "Strong"
mut_info$group[which(mut_info$min_pval >= 0.001)] = "Weak"

table(mut_info$group)

tapply(mut_info$n, mut_info$group, table)

mut_info$n_group = cut(mut_info$n, breaks = c(4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 10.5, 20.5, 50.5, Inf),
                      labels = c("5", "6", "7-10", "11-20", "21-50", ">50"))

mut_info$group <- factor(mut_info$group, levels = c("No", "Weak", "Strong"))
tapply(mut_info$n_group, mut_info$group, function(x){table(x)/length(x)})

ggplot(mut_info, aes(x = group, fill = n_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  labs(
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "mutation\nfrequency"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


## Check those matched mutations 

```{r}
mut_dat = mut_dat[match(mut_info$key, mut_dat$key),]
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

mut_dat = merge(mut_dat, mut_info)
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

table(mut_dat$asso_TCR, mut_dat$group)

table(mut_dat$Feature == mut_dat$Transcript_ID)
table(mut_dat$NCBI_Build)
tapply(mut_dat$Variant_Classification, mut_info$asso_TCR, table)

table(mut_dat$Variant_Classification, mut_dat$Variant_Type)

fwrite(mut_dat, file.path(result_dir, "step7_mutations.tsv"), sep="\t")
```

# Extract amino acid sequence

## First test the version of Ensembl to use

After checking all the URLs from 2019, https://grch37.ensembl.org is the only one that give the BRAF V600E correct annoation. 

Not running this code here since it oftens has error of operation timed out.

```{r eval=FALSE}
mut_dat[Hugo_Symbol == "TP53",][1:2,]
mut_dat[Hugo_Symbol == "BRAF",][1:2,]

# since the mutations were annotated around 2019
# we should use an archived version of ensembl

urls  = listEnsemblArchives()$url[c(1,3, 17:18)]
urls
wt_aa  = len_aa = NULL
wt_cdna  = len_cdna = NULL

for(i in 1:length(urls)){
  u1 = urls[i]
  ensembl = useMart("ensembl", dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl", 
                    host=u1)
  
  enst = c("ENST00000269305", "ENST00000288602")
  seq_i = getSequence(id=enst, 
                      type="ensembl_transcript_id",
                      seqType="peptide", mart=ensembl)
  
  dna_i = getSequence(id=enst, 
                      type="ensembl_transcript_id",
                      seqType="coding", mart=ensembl)

  stopifnot(all(seq_i$ensembl_transcript_id == enst))
  stopifnot(all(dna_i$ensembl_transcript_id == enst))

  len_aa_i = nchar(seq_i$peptide)
  len_cdna_i = nchar(dna_i$coding)
  
  aa_t = translate(DNAStringSet(dna_i$coding))
  aa_t = as.character(aa_t)
  
  stopifnot(all(aa_t == seq_i$peptide))
  
  wt_aa_i  = rep(NA, 2)
  wt_aa_i[1]  = substr(seq_i$peptide[1], 343, 343)
  wt_aa_i[2]  = substr(seq_i$peptide[2], 600, 600)
  
  wt_cdna_i  = rep(NA, 2)

  wt_cdna_i[1]  = substr(dna_i$coding[1], 1027, 1027)
  wt_cdna_i[2]  = substr(dna_i$coding[2], 1799, 1799)

  wt_aa  = rbind(wt_aa, wt_aa_i)
  len_aa = rbind(len_aa, len_aa_i)
  
  wt_cdna  = rbind(wt_cdna, wt_cdna_i)
  len_cdna = rbind(len_cdna, len_cdna_i)
}

cbind(wt_aa, len_aa, wt_cdna, len_cdna, urls)
```

## Extract AA sequences

Extract AA sequence for 1000 transcripts each time.

```{r eval=FALSE}
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

t_transcript = table(mut_dat$Transcript_ID)
length(t_transcript)
table(t_transcript)

x = sort(t_transcript, decreasing = TRUE)
df1 = data.frame(x, mut_dat$Hugo_Symbol[match(names(x), mut_dat$Transcript_ID)])
names(df1) = c("transcript", "freq", "gene")
dim(df1)
df1[1:20,]

table(table(df1$gene))
sort(table(df1$gene), decreasing = TRUE)[1:6]

starts = seq(1, nrow(df1), by=100)
ends = c(seq(100, nrow(df1), by=100), nrow(df1))

cbind(starts, ends)

peptide = coding = NULL

ensembl = useMart("ensembl", dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl", 
                  host="https://grch37.ensembl.org")

for(i in 1:length(starts)){
  cat(i, date(), "\n")
  est = df1$transcript[starts[i]:ends[i]]
  
  seq_i = getSequence(id=est, type="ensembl_transcript_id", 
                      seqType="peptide", mart=ensembl)
  
  dna_i = getSequence(id=est, type="ensembl_transcript_id", 
                      seqType="coding", mart=ensembl)

  stopifnot(setequal(est, seq_i$ensembl_transcript_id))
  stopifnot(setequal(est, dna_i$ensembl_transcript_id))

  seq_i = seq_i[match(est, seq_i$ensembl_transcript_id),]
  dna_i = dna_i[match(est, dna_i$ensembl_transcript_id),]
  
  peptide = rbind(peptide, seq_i)
  coding  = rbind(coding, dna_i)
}

dim(peptide)
peptide[1:2,]

dim(coding)
coding[1:2,]

peptide = data.frame(peptide)
names(peptide)[2] = "transcript"

coding = data.frame(coding)
names(coding)[2] = "transcript"

df2 = merge(df1, peptide)
dim(df2)
df2[1:2,]

df2 = merge(df2, coding)
dim(df2)
df2[1:2,]

fwrite(df2, file.path(result_dir, "step7_peptide_seq.tsv"), sep="\t")
```
